note: Example data: an invented candle and home-fragrance store with an invented Shopify store, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "ecommerce-ads-playbook" skill. Run a store growth audit on our Shopify store for the last 90 days. I pasted our orders export (plus the year before), the products export, a GA4 channel and device export, PageSpeed results, our Klaviyo flows and the review app export. What should we fix first?

store.name: Harbor & Pine Candle Co. (invented example)
store.what_it_sells: hand-poured soy candles, reed diffusers, wax melts, room sprays, gift sets and candle accessories

user_inputs.gross_margin: not known, so priced fixes are in revenue
user_inputs.abandoned_checkout_recovery_rate: not known, so the 5% assumption applies

source: Shopify orders and products exports, Shopify abandoned checkouts report, GA4 export, PageSpeed Insights results, Klaviyo flow list and form report, review app export, policy links and a Merchant Center product status export, all pasted by the user; no connector

orders_export.format: one row per order, fields separated by |

prior_orders_export.format: customer|date, one row per paid order in the 12 months before the window

merchant_center_return_policy: set (30 days, free returns on damaged items)

discount_settings_export.type: 15% off a first order, from the signup pop-up
25% off for the repeat-buyer segment, sent by email
automatic discount on 2 or more candles
